title: Factorisation of expectation over product functions
statement:
Let $g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be given coordinatewise, so that for each index $i \in \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ we have a function $g_i : \{0,1\} \to \bbr$, and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be the product function $f(x) = \prod_{i} g_i(x_i)$. Then its uniform expectation over the Boolean hypercube factorises as
\[
  \E[f] = \prod_{i} \frac{g_i(0) + g_i(1)}{2}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: g is a family of functions g_i : {0,1} → ℝ indexed by the n coordinates
f is the product function x ↦ ∏_i g_i(x_i)
